svg.title: Canonical diagram: The architecture of governance failure
svg.desc: A vertical flow diagram showing how high-dimensional disturbance environments are compressed through governance observation architecture into decisions and actions, with feedback loops blocked by immune responses and bypass architectures emerging around blocked channels.

g.text: Standing · evidence rules · metrics · categories · precedent
Empirical feedback → immune response → symbolic adaptation
Bypass architectures emerge where feedback is blocked

svg.text: Variety loss — signal degraded at filter/compression points
Bypass architecture — routes around blocked core
Missing feedback — empirical signal that never reaches decision layer
